risks.reviewFocus: Local/BYOK/Managed labels, explicit forks, no silent routing across trust boundaries. Chrome may append-only mirror a signed-in conversation only when every turn is proven Managed Cloud; unknown provenance or any Local/BYOK turn permanently disqualifies it, and local storage remains authoritative. The Electron shell is Managed-Cloud-only and must not expose Tauri Local/BYOK commands. VS Code developer sessions remain workspace-scoped and must use the CLI-reported trust mode before send. Desktop egressGuard.ts is FETCH-ONLY: JS our-cloud fetches must use guardedFetch. Rust's PublicHttpClient is the fail-closed initial-URL plus every-redirect boundary for source-proven arbitrary-public webhook, API-tool, upload/download, and scrape transports. KNOWN GAP: Rust transport still has no global enforced chokepoint across every provider/account/integration client; do not route chat/file/session payloads on an unclassified transport.
